method.name: getBytes
method.lead: Gets the bytes corresponding to the whole message, including the CRC.
method.description: Gets the bytes corresponding to the whole message, including the CRC. The generated byte[] array may be sent to an EnOcean gateway and is conform to EnOcean Radio Protocol.
method.return: The serialized byte list corresponding to the binary message.

method.name: getPayloadBytes
method.lead: Returns the payload bytes of this message.
method.description: Returns the payload bytes of this message.

method.name: getStatus
method.lead: Gets the current EnOcean status of the Message.
method.description: Gets the current EnOcean status of the Message. The 'status' byte is actually a bitfield that mainly holds repeater information, teach-in status, and more or less information depending on the radiotelegram type.
method.return: the current EnOcean status of this message.

method.name: getSubTelNum
method.lead: Returns the number of subtelegrams (usually 1) this Message carries.
method.description: Returns the number of subtelegrams (usually 1) this Message carries.
method.return: The number of subtelegrams in the case of multiframe messages.

method.name: getDbm
method.lead: Returns the average RSSI on all the received subtelegrams, including redundant ones.
method.description: Returns the average RSSI on all the received subtelegrams, including redundant ones.

method.name: getSecurityLevelFormat
method.lead: Returns the security level of this message, as specified in the 'Security of EnOcean Radio Networks' draft, section 4.2.1.3.
method.description: Returns the security level of this message, as specified in the 'Security of EnOcean Radio Networks' draft, section 4.2.1.3.

class.name: EnOceanChannelDescription
class.lead: Public and registered description interface for a channel.
class.description: Public and registered description interface for a channel. Encompasses all the possible subtypes for a channel.
class.author: @author $Id: 61b21375118e33bd04c3ede4f4d8374e927ce076 $

method.name: getType
method.lead: Retrieves the type of the channel.
method.description: Retrieves the type of the channel.

method.name: serialize
method.lead: Tries to serialize the channel into a series of bytes.
method.description: Tries to serialize the channel into a series of bytes.
method.param: the value of the channel.
method.return: the right-aligned value, in raw bytes, of the channel.

method.name: deserialize
method.lead: Tries to deserialize a series of bytes into a documented value object (raw bytes, Double or {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue}.
method.description: Tries to deserialize a series of bytes into a documented value object (raw bytes, Double or {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue}. Of course this method will be specialized for each {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} subinterface, depending on the type of this channel.
method.param: the right-aligned raw bytes.

field.name: CHANNEL_ID
field.lead: The unique ID of this EnOceanChannelDescription object.
field.description: The unique ID of this EnOceanChannelDescription object.

field.name: TYPE_RAW
field.lead: A RAW channel is only made of bytes.
field.description: A RAW channel is only made of bytes.

field.name: TYPE_DATA
field.lead: A DATA channel maps itself to a {@link Double} value representing a physical measure.
field.description: A DATA channel maps itself to a {@link Double} value representing a physical measure.

field.name: TYPE_FLAG
field.lead: A FLAG channel maps itself to a {@link Boolean} value.
field.description: A FLAG channel maps itself to a {@link Boolean} value.

field.name: TYPE_ENUM
field.lead: An ENUM channel maps itself to one between a list of discrete {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue} "value objects".
field.description: An ENUM channel maps itself to one between a list of discrete {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue} "value objects".
